name: retgas
description: Ask about your gas inspection operation in RETGAS: inspectors, certificates, visits, reports and how-to help. Read-only.

interface.longDescription: RETGAS is the management platform for gas inspection bodies in Colombia. This plugin lets an inspection body ask about its own operation in plain language, read-only, with the same permissions and sites each user has in the RETGAS web app. Ask about active inspectors, who is ready for field work, certificates and competencies about to expire, equipment calibration, vehicles and documents; visits and inspection reports by inspector, site, service type or month, and where reports are returned or annulled; deliveries to gas distributors; whether an inspector is correctly set up for the mobile app and which devices are authorized; and step-by-step help on using the web and mobile apps. You sign in with your RETGAS account; there are no API keys to copy. The plugin never writes data, never runs free-form SQL and never returns personal data of gas service customers or free-text notes.
defaultPrompt: How many active inspectors do we have in RETGAS?
Whose certificates expire in the next 60 days?
How do I add a new gas distributor in RETGAS?
